card.name: The word sometimes
card.fires_on: The word "sometimes", mostly capitalized at the start of a sentence, but also mid-sentence before a verb or adjective. It appears in general prose and in drug-effect text.

modes.label: Sentence-opening Sometimes
modes.description: "Sometimes" begins a new sentence, often followed by a comma or a subject.
modes.example: spam emails. <<Sometimes>>, spammers will hijack someone else

modes.label: Mid-sentence sometimes
modes.description: Lowercase "sometimes" sits inside a sentence, before a verb or adjective that describes occasional effects.
modes.example: ions<< sometimes>> depress the circulation when administered intravenously

card.writes: It promotes words that continue a contrast or an unexpected point, such as "even" and "sogar", with no other clear effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "sometimes", which marks something that happens only on occasion.
